title: R18 Rocter Bagger
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the BMW Motorrad R18 Rocter Bagger is born on the race grid to deliver uncompromised high-speed aerodynamic downforce. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 110 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Aggressive Forward Tuck posture paired with a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 5.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
